name: recurring
description: One recurring intention: every day at 20:00 she means to look for memes for the evening, set on day 1 and expiring on day 6 at midnight. The stub closes the occurrence (state=done) on four evenings and stays silent on day 3, which the engine records as missed; the day-5 wake is the last occurrence before the expiry and carries its note; on day 6 the intention expires with nothing more due.
